# dsh-git
Git in the DeepSeek Harness composer and sidebar: a repo/branch chip, a header button, and a split G
it panel with staging, commit, history and diffs.
## What it adds
**1. Branch chip in the composer.** A small pill sits in the composer trailing cluster, left of the
model picker and the session-stats control:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
It shows the repository name, the current branch, ahead/behind markers, and a dirty dot. Click it to
open the Git panel.
**2. Git button in the conversation header.** The same action from the top-right utilities row of an
the conversation header.** The same action from the top-right utilities row of an open conversation.
**3. A split Git panel in the sidebar.**
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- **Top-left**: staged and unstaged files, laid out as the repository's own folder tree (collapsible
folders with file counts, not a flat list). Stage/unstage a single file or everything, discard a tr
acked change behind an inline confirm, write a commit message, and generate one with AI (uses the Ha
rness default model, and reports a clear error when no model is configured). Ctrl/Cmd+Enter commits.
- **Top-right**: commit history with a branch switcher, a text filter, continuous branch lanes draw
n down the left edge (the rails run edge-to-edge through every row, including expanded file lists, w
ith the commit dot on the first text line), expandable rows that list the files of the commit, and a
right-click menu (copy hash, `reset --soft/mixed/hard`, `revert`). Each row leads with GitLens-styl
e ref chips — a tick for the checked-out HEAD, a branch glyph for local branches, a globe for remote
-tracking refs, a tag glyph for tags — sitting at the right of the subject on the same line, with `s

hort hash · author · age` underneath.
- **Bottom**: the diff of whatever you clicked — a working-tre
e file, a staged file, or one specific file inside a commit (only that file's patch, never the whole
staged file, or one specific file inside a commit (only that file's patch, never the whole commit).
**Narrow screens.** Below 720px the two-column grid collapses into one stacked column (changes, hist
ory, diff), panes keep their own scroll with sensible max heights, tap targets grow, the short hash
hides, the filter box moves to its own row, and per-file actions stay visible on touch devices where
ox moves to its own row, and per-file actions stay visible on touch devices where there is no hover.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart the Harness after installing: client plugins are loaded at boot.
## dsh-better-sidebar
dsh-better-sidebar is supported and preferred when installed. dsh-git registers its panel through `c
tx.betterSidebar.registerTab` (order 25, single instance) and skips its own native right-sidebar tab
, so you never end up with two Git tabs. Without better-sidebar it falls back to a plain right-sideb
u never end up with two Git tabs. Without better-sidebar it falls back to a plain right-sidebar tab.
better-sidebar mirrors native tab kinds into its own registry, so registering a native kind and a be
tter-sidebar tab under the same id makes its bridge throw `tab kind "..." is already registered`. Th
e two registrations therefore use separate, author-tagged ids — `dsh-git-by-weidows` (better-sidebar
tab) and `dsh-git-native-by-weidows` (native kind) — and the native kind is never registered while
the service is present. Both carry a full description for the new-tab list: repo and branch status,
changes and staging, commits, history and diffs.
The panel can also be opened by other plugins:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Host API
All traffic goes through `POST /plugins/dsh-git/api/<method>` with a JSON body and returns `{ ok: tr
ue, data }` or `{ ok: false, error: { message } }`. Requests are rejected with 403 unless they come
from the Harness connection. Every git call is `execFile("git", argv)` — never a shell — with a vali
dated working directory, pathspecs after `--`, and 24 MB output caps.
| method | body | returns |
| `state` | { cwd } | repo name, branch, ahead/behind, file list with per-file index/worktree state

|
| `diff` | { cwd, mode: "worktree" or "staged", path? } | unified patch of the working tree, the i

ndex, or one file |
| `log` | { cwd, ref?, search?, limit? } | commits (hash, short, subject, author

, date, refs) |
| `commit` | { cwd, hash } | commit meta, changed files with +/- counts, patch |
| `

commit-files` | { cwd, hash } | files of a commit |
| `commit-file` | { cwd, hash, path } | patch of

one file inside a commit |
| `stage` / `unstage` | { cwd, paths: [] } | fresh state |
| `discard` |

{ cwd, paths: [] } | fresh state (tracked files only) |
| `commit-create` | { cwd, message, all? }

| fresh state |
| `reset` | { cwd, hash, mode: "soft", "mixed" or "hard" } | fresh state |
| `revert

` | { cwd, hash } | fresh state |
| `suggest` | { cwd, sessionId?, language? } | AI commit message d
erived from the staged/working diff |
## Safety
- `reset --hard`, `revert` and `discard` are destructive; they are only reachable from explicit clic
ks in the panel. A revert that hits a conflict is rolled back with `git revert --abort`, so the work

ing tree is never left mid-merge.
- Discarding an untracked file is refused instead of deleting it,

and untracked files never show the discard action in the panel.
- Pathspecs and branch names are val

idated (no leading `-`, no whitespace or `..` in branches) and passed after `--`.
- The plugin never
runs a shell, never prompts for credentials (`GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0`), and never reads anything out
side the session working directory.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The client half is a plain Harness client plugin (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`) that registers Rea
ct components into slots:

- `conversation.input.right` — the branch chip
- `conversation.session.header.utilities` — the heade

r button
- `sidebar.right.pane.tab` — the native tab body (only when better-sidebar is absent)
